coverage.full: the entire translated maxim (identical to matn: these reports carry no isnad or takhrij)
coverage.matn: the saying only, aligned as a whole span to the Arabic witness matn

source.citation: sunnah.com, '40 Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi' (scraped 2026-07-27). Not a scholarly edition; translator not asserted.

method: direct: no isnad preamble or takhrij is present in the source, so full == matn == the scraped English string, unaltered apart from whitespace normalization

translations.full: The report is not like witnessing.
translations.matn: The report is not like witnessing.

translations.full: War is deception.
translations.matn: War is deception.

translations.full: A Muslim is a mirror of the Muslim.
translations.matn: A Muslim is a mirror of the Muslim.

translations.full: Someone whose advice is sought is in a position of trust.
translations.matn: Someone whose advice is sought is in a position of trust.

translations.full: The person guiding (someone) to do a good deed, is like the one performing the good deed.
translations.matn: The person guiding (someone) to do a good deed, is like the one performing the good deed.

translations.full: Seek help for any needs discreetly.
translations.matn: Seek help for any needs discreetly.

translations.full: Protect yourself from the fire even with a part of a date.
translations.matn: Protect yourself from the fire even with a part of a date.

translations.full: The world is the believer’s prison and the disbeliever’s paradise.
translations.matn: The world is the believer’s prison and the disbeliever’s paradise.

translations.full: Modesty is entirely good.
translations.matn: Modesty is entirely good.

translations.full: The word of the believer is like seizing of the hand.
translations.matn: The word of the believer is like seizing of the hand.

translations.full: It is unlawful for a believer to sever relations with his brother for more than three days.
translations.matn: It is unlawful for a believer to sever relations with his brother for more than three days.

translations.full: He is not one of us who cheats us.
translations.matn: He is not one of us who cheats us.

translations.full: A little that suffices is better than an abundance that distracts.
translations.matn: A little that suffices is better than an abundance that distracts.

translations.full: Someone who takes back his gift is like someone who eats his vomit.
translations.matn: Someone who takes back his gift is like someone who eats his vomit.

translations.full: Affliction comes from (loose) talk.
translations.matn: Affliction comes from (loose) talk.

translations.full: People are like the teeth of a comb.
translations.matn: People are like the teeth of a comb.

translations.full: Richness lies in the richness of the soul.
translations.matn: Richness lies in the richness of the soul.

translations.full: The felicitous person takes lessons from (the actions of) others.
translations.matn: The felicitous person takes lessons from (the actions of) others.

translations.full: Indeed, in poetry there is wisdom and in eloquence there is magic.
translations.matn: Indeed, in poetry there is wisdom and in eloquence there is magic.

translations.full: The king’s pardon preserves the kingdom.
translations.matn: The king’s pardon preserves the kingdom.

translations.full: A man will be with whom he loves.
translations.matn: A man will be with whom he loves.

translations.full: A man who knows his worth will not be ruined.
translations.matn: A man who knows his worth will not be ruined.

translations.full: The child belongs to the bed and stoning is for the adulterer.
translations.matn: The child belongs to the bed and stoning is for the adulterer.

translations.full: The upper hand is superior to the lower hand.
translations.matn: The upper hand is superior to the lower hand.

translations.full: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people.
translations.matn: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people.

translations.full: Your love of something can blind and deafen (you).
translations.matn: Your love of something can blind and deafen (you).

translations.full: Hearts are predisposed to love someone who does them good and detest someone who does them harm.
translations.matn: Hearts are predisposed to love someone who does them good and detest someone who does them harm.

translations.full: One who repents from sin is like someone without sin.
translations.matn: One who repents from sin is like someone without sin.

translations.full: The person who actually witnesses an (event) sees that which one who is absent does not.
translations.matn: The person who actually witnesses an (event) sees that which one who is absent does not.

translations.full: If the nobleman of a people comes to you, honour him.
translations.matn: If the nobleman of a people comes to you, honour him.

translations.full: False oaths lay waste to home (lands).
translations.matn: False oaths lay waste to home (lands).

translations.full: Whoever is killed attempting to save his property is a martyr.
translations.matn: Whoever is killed attempting to save his property is a martyr.

translations.full: Actions are through intentions.
translations.matn: Actions are through intentions.

translations.full: The leader of a people is their servant.
translations.matn: The leader of a people is their servant.

translations.full: The best of affairs is that which is balanced.
translations.matn: The best of affairs is that which is balanced.

translations.full: O Allah, bless my nation in its early rising on Thursdays!
translations.matn: O Allah, bless my nation in its early rising on Thursdays!

translations.full: Poverty can almost turn into disbelief.
translations.matn: Poverty can almost turn into disbelief.

translations.full: Travelling is a portion of punishment.
translations.matn: Travelling is a portion of punishment.

translations.full: The best of provision is God-Consciousness (taqwa).
translations.matn: The best of provision is God-Consciousness (taqwa).

translations.full: Meetings are under trust.
translations.matn: Meetings are under trust.
